mission: Replace broad SchemaUtils codec-static bundles with safe, selected, hoisted statics and migrate all existing usages to the minimal required set.

provenance.note: Authored directly from a 2026-08-30 SchemaUtils design review and /grilling session; decisions are recorded in DECISIONS.md and made normative by SPEC.md.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

openQuestions.question: Must withCodecStatics require a non-empty key tuple with no zero-argument compatibility overload?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes; make explicit selection mandatory and delete the broad behavior.

openQuestions.question: Should S.Class schemas use a nested frozen utility bag bound with classStatics(this, keys)?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes; it preserves Effect's class implementation and allows consumer-side destructuring without constructor magic.

openQuestions.question: Should JSON-string convenience names stay out of the selector in favor of explicit named S.fromJsonString schemas?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes; separate construction-time JSON options from per-call parse options and prevent accidental double wrapping.

stopConditions: The /grilling frontier is non-empty or shared understanding is not explicitly confirmed.
Safe class binding would require a custom Schema implementation or Effect-internal mutation.
An exported schema's minimal public helper surface cannot be established from repository evidence.
JSON option ownership would rebuild a codec on each business-function call.
Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The implementation would exceed named scope.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
